scope: FAA recreational-flight baseline. Work-related filming requires a separate assessment under Part 107.

registrationRequired.note: Recreational drones weighing 250 g or more require registration. International operators must check additional steps.

pilotCertRequired.note: Recreational pilots must complete TRUST and carry proof.

altitudeNote: 400 ft in Class G airspace. Controlled airspace requires prior FAA authorization and may have lower limits.
maxDistanceRule: Keep the aircraft within visual line of sight (or use a co-located visual observer).

insuranceRequired.note: Not verified in this summary. Check the national authority for your aircraft and operation.

importRestriction.note: Import and radio-equipment requirements have not been verified.

noFlyHighlights: Check temporary restrictions and the FAA's current airspace tools.
notes: Registered aircraft generally require Remote ID unless operating within an applicable exception. This summary does not assess commercial filming, launch-site rules or foreign registration.
